page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360-lssd is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. The system delivers 360 dedicated virtual CPUs across 180 physical cores with multi-threading enabled, accompanied by 2880 GB of system memory, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Local storage consists of 12864 GB of integrated NVMe SSD capacity spread across 32 drives. There are no graphics processing units attached to this configuration.

Benchmark data confirms exceptional parallel compute and throughput metrics. The instance achieved top-tier rankings in multi-core stress testing with a score of 554437.38 and a PassMark CPU score of 156675.88. High computational capabilities extend to Clang software compilation and ray tracing workloads. Memory performance is equally elevated, showing uncached read bandwidth of 701.26 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 354.62 GB/sec. Redis SET operations measured at 393.33 million operations per second, complemented by static web serving throughput of 146.18 GB/sec.

From an architectural standpoint, the integration of 12.8 TB of fast local NVMe storage paired with dense memory bandwidth minimizes external disk latency and maximizes transactional throughput. Single-threaded benchmarks, such as standard gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, operate closer to median levels, confirming that this machine maximizes scale via horizontal parallelism rather than peak single-thread execution speed.

The c3d-highmem-360-lssd instance is engineered for resource-dense enterprise deployments. Primary workload fits include high-capacity in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale Clang code compilation pipelines, data analytics platforms, and localized prompt processing for large language models requiring substantial system memory footprint.
